collect_env_info: run collect_env_info to gather and print the full detectron2 environment information including GPU, CUDA, and PyTorch details
collect_torch_env: run collect_torch_env to retrieve and display the PyTorch configuration and environment details
get_env_module: run get_env_module to retrieve the DETECTRON2_ENV_MODULE environment variable name and its current value
detect_compute_compatibility: run detect_compute_compatibility with a CUDA_HOME path and shared object file to detect compiled GPU architecture flags
review_collect_env: review the collect_env module to understand how detectron2 environment diagnostics are collected and formatted
